AXIS Franka Datasets v2
	

Simulation demonstrations for learning language-conditioned Franka manipulation policies, collected with the AXIS data engine.

AXIS is a community-driven robot data engine that collects human demonstrations through browser-based teleoperation and turns them into training data through automated task validation and simulation rendering.
